author: Solid jj
description:
The Justice League discuss what should be Supergirl's basic, comprehensible personal character lore, but as it turns out there were drugs much more accessible to comic book writers back in the day and they'd put her (and others!) in some of the most confusing situations as was possible to fit in her books. Read some! Or don't! Just watch the video! That's pretty much the same, right?
